title: M3D-NCA: Robust 3D Segmentation with Built-in Quality Control
layout_note: Top panel: a left-to-right pipeline (input -> downscale -> NCA -> upscale -> concatenate) whose level repetition returns as a long arrow under the row to 'Select Random Patch'; two detail panels below (NCA architecture, batch duplication).
grouping: Three light-grey rounded panels with large bold titles ('M3D-NCA: Training Pipeline' above, 'NCA Architecture' and 'Batch Duplication' below); inside the pipeline panel a lavender tinted region holds what repeats per level (scaling, the NCA, the loss), and inside the architecture panel a lavender region holds the layer stack.
shapes_depth: Strongly 3-D: bevelled extruded blocks with gradient shading and drop shadows for Downscale / Upscale (prisms), Concatenate (tall grey block), Dice FocalLoss (yellow block) and NCA (purple cube); image volumes are 3-D cubes textured with MRI slices; layers are purple 3-D slabs with rotated labels.
proposed_highlight: The NCA is a purple cube wrapped by a large circular arrow ('Apply Model m_x -> s times') in the middle of the lavender per-level region; purple is reused for the architecture's layers, the batch-duplication 'M3D NCA' cube and the predicted mask overlay.
lesson: Draw a model applied s times as a cube with a circular arrow wrapped round it, and the outer per-level repetition as a long return arrow around the whole row, so the two nested repetitions differ by size.
notes: Venue written as arXiv: the arXiv v1 first page states no venue; remembered venue MICCAI 2023 (unverified). year = arXiv preprint year.

taxonomy.task: 3-D medical image segmentation with neural cellular automata applied repeatedly across image scales

insights.structure: A full-width training-pipeline panel on top and two smaller detail panels below it, each panel framed in light grey with a large bold title and a lavender tint marking what repeats.
insights.data: Images are 3-D cubes showing MRI slices: the input volume, a selected patch with a purple predicted-mask overlay, the downscaled intermediates and the ground-truth patch; batch duplication shows three copies of one input cube.
insights.emphasis: The NCA cube is the only saturated purple element in the pipeline and is circled by the largest arrow, at the centre of the lavender region.
insights.flow: The main row runs left to right in short straight arrows; the per-level repetition returns as a long dark arrow from Concatenate under the row to the patch, and orange arrows run up from the patch into Downscale and down from the NCA output into the loss.
insights.avoid: Every routine operation (downscale, upscale, concatenate) is a heavily shaded 3-D block as prominent as the NCA, and orange is used for two unrelated arrows without a key.

arrangement.units: a full-width light-grey panel for the training pipeline (with a lavender tinted inner region for one level) above two light-grey panels side by side for the NCA architecture and batch duplication; each titled in large bold text
arrangement.inputs_as: a 3-D MRI volume cube labelled 'Input Image', and below it a cube with a highlighted random patch
arrangement.losses_at: a yellow 3-D 'Dice FocalLoss' block at the bottom of the lavender region, fed by the ground-truth patch from its left and by an orange arrow from the NCA output above, with an italic note 'After n levels calculate loss on final patch'
arrangement.shared: the NCA is drawn twice as a purple cube with a circular arrow ('NCA m_x' in the pipeline, 'M3D NCA' in batch duplication); the downscale and upscale prisms share one grey style

core.what: two nested repetitions drawn at two sizes: a circular arrow hugging the NCA cube ('Apply Model m_x -> s times') inside the lavender per-level region, and a long return arrow ('For each level n-1') from Concatenate under the whole row back to the patch selection

relations.form: the NCA's s steps as one circular arrow wrapped round the purple cube, not unrolled
the level loop as a long dark arrow leaving Concatenate, running left under the row and down into 'Select Random Patch', which re-enters Downscale by an orange arrow
input cube -> Downscale prism -> downscaled cube -> NCA cube -> output cube -> Upscale prism -> Concatenate block, one horizontal row of short arrows

the NCA Architecture panel below opens the NCA cube (Conv3d and Identity branches -> Dense-h -> Batch Norm -> ReLU -> Dense-c -> '+' Update Cell), tied to it only by the shared purple, not by a callout
Batch Duplication: one input batch fans out into three identical copies stacked in a lavender column (⊙ between them) that converge on one M3D NCA cube

channels.colour: purple = the NCA (cubes, architecture layers, predicted mask overlay) and, as a pale lavender tint, the region that repeats per level - one hue family for module and scope; yellow = loss; light grey/white = fixed scaling and concatenation ops; orange arrows = two different paths (patch into the next level, output into the loss), unkeyed
channels.shape: 3-D cubes = image volumes and the NCA, prisms = scale changes, tall block = concatenate, flat 3-D slabs = layers, '+' and ⊙ glyphs = operations
channels.line: dark grey arrows = data flow, circular arrows = repetition, thick orange arrows = patch-to-level and output-to-loss
channels.frame: light-grey rounded panel = one sub-figure with one job; lavender inner region = what repeats per level or what is inside the NCA

quality.strengths: the method's two repetitions are distinguished by geometry (a tight circular arrow round the NCA vs a long return arrow round the row); data is drawn as data - MRI volume cubes, the selected patch, the predicted mask in purple, the ground-truth patch; each panel has one job (pipeline, cell update, batch duplication) and the pipeline panel takes most of the area
quality.weaknesses: all operations are shaded 3-D extruded blocks, so the routine Downscale/Upscale/Concatenate weigh as much as the NCA; orange carries two unrelated paths without a key; the level-loop arrow detours around the entire row; what Concatenate joins (the input arrow along the top edge with the upscaled output) is not explained by the drawing; purple means both 'NCA' and 'repeated region'

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
